power.title: Horsepower, by engine
power.sub: Toyota's figures. The SR figure is for 2022. The hybrid number is combined system output.

torque.title: Peak torque, by engine
torque.sub: Pound-feet, as advertised. The hybrid makes its 583 lb-ft at 2,400 rpm, against 3,600 rpm for the 5.7-liter V8's 401.

mpg.title: Fuel economy, 4x4
mpg.sub: EPA combined miles per gallon for 4x4 versions. Rear-drive trucks are rated 1 or 2 mpg higher.

fuelcost.title: A year of fuel
fuelcost.sub: 15,000 miles at $4 a gallon, using the EPA combined figures above: 14, 19 and 20 mpg. An example, not a forecast.

recall.title: The engine recalls, by size
recall.sub: Vehicles in each US recall for machining debris in the twin-turbo V6. Each one extends the last to trucks built later.

tow.title: How much it can tow
tow.sub: Toyota's maximum towing ratings, in kilograms, with pounds in parentheses. Each applies only to specific cab, bed and drive combinations.
